items.note: In the description of "a customer request to travel from x to y", is the destination y required to be located at an intersection?

items.name: 林奕汝
items.note:
"No, it can be any place on the road." The teacher answered this question after the class of this week.

Also for term project, may I ask about the information of this project: "Assume all intersection nodes have the same parameter λ for average customer calls for the time period in a day." 
Does that means each intersection have averagely 1 call within the hour while λ is 1, and overall 40ish calls from different intersections in that hour?
